Page.title: Page
Page.description: Represents a page on the website, allowing for CMS-style editing.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Page entity.

slug.description: The URL-friendly slug for the page (e.g., 'about-us').

content.description: The HTML or JSON content of the page.

lastUpdated.description: The date and time the page was last updated.

Media.title: Media
Media.description: Represents a media file stored in the storage bucket.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Media entity.

filename.description: The original filename of the media file.

url.description: The URL where the media file can be accessed.

mimeType.description: The MIME type of the media file (e.g., 'image/jpeg').

size.description: The size of the media file in bytes.

uploadDate.description: The date and time the media file was uploaded.

PageElement.title: PageElement
PageElement.description: Represents a reusable element that can be dragged and dropped onto a page.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PageElement entity.

name.description: The name of the element (e.g., 'Hero Section', 'Contact Form').

content.description: The content of the element, which could be HTML or JSON data.

order.description: The order in which the element appears on the page.

definition.description: Stores page content for the website. Accessible and editable only by admins (users with a document in /roles_admin/{uid}).

params.name: pageId
params.description: The unique identifier for the page.

definition.description: Stores reusable elements associated with a specific page. Includes denormalized `pageId` to allow easy access to the page content. Accessible and editable only by admins (users with a document in /roles_admin/{uid}).

params.name: pageId
params.description: The unique identifier for the page.

params.name: pageElementId
params.description: The unique identifier for the page element.

definition.description: Stores media files uploaded to the storage bucket.  Accessible and editable only by admins (users with a document in /roles_admin/{uid}).

params.name: mediaId
params.description: The unique identifier for the media file.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user.

firestore.reasoning:
This design prioritizes security and scalability for the Construction Specialties application. The structure is designed around the principle of Authorization Independence, achieved by denormalizing authorization data where necessary to avoid using `get()` calls in Firestore rules. This ensures atomic operations and simplifies debugging. Structural Segregation is applied by separating content based on access needs (e.g., global CMS content managed by admins). The design incorporates explicit state modeling using dedicated status fields. QAPs are supported by structuring content by access requirements, enabling secure `list` operations.

Specifically, the `pages` collection is globally accessible to admins, managed via existence in the `/roles_admin/{uid}` collection. The `pageElements` are stored as a subcollection of `pages` and include the `pageId` to correctly associate elements to their parent page.
